patch.objective: Narrow a union with typeof, in, instanceof, equality checks and truthiness
secondaryObjectives: Combine types with unions and intersections, and use literal types to restrict values

sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch: 0, NaN, '', 0n, null and undefined 'all coerce to false'; a truthiness check 'has a subtle downside: we may no longer be handling the empty string case correctly'; an explicit check such as !== null removes only null. In this band the discount is typed number | null, and || narrows by truthiness, treating 0 as missing.

sources.cite: MDN Web Docs, Nullish coalescing operator (??)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch. ?? 'returns its right-hand side operand when its left-hand side operand is null or undefined'; || returns the right operand for any falsy value, so a default given with || overrides usable falsy values such as 0 or ''. Example: count || 42 gives 42, not 0.
Every organization, person, count and deadline is invented teaching data; tool output is an authored rendering in the tool style.
